title: Reaching to the Ends of the Earth

request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, light percussion, reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Trembling took hold of them there
Anguish like a woman in labor
With an east wind you shattered the ships
We heard it and now we see

[Pre-Chorus]
In the city of the Lord of hosts
In the city of our God
He will establish her forever
We have pondered your steadfast love

[Chorus]
Like your name O God
So is your praise
Reaching to the ends of the earth
Your right hand is filled
With righteousness for all

[Verse]
What we had heard we have now seen
In the holy place of God
He will establish her forever
We have pondered your steadfast love

[Pre-Chorus]
In the city of the Lord of hosts
In the city of our God
He will establish her forever
We have pondered your steadfast love

[Chorus]
Like your name O God
So is your praise
Reaching to the ends of the earth
Your right hand is filled
With righteousness for all

[Bridge]
Let Mount Zion rejoice
Let the daughters of Judah be glad
Because of your judgments
Walk around Zion
Circle her count her towers

[Chorus]
Like your name O God
So is your praise
Reaching to the ends of the earth
Your right hand is filled
With righteousness for all

[Outro]
Reaching to the ends of the earth
Your right hand is filled with righteousness
